description: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0) in-process mediator for .NET 8 and .NET 10 with a MediatR-compatible API: requests, stream requests, notifications, pipeline behaviors, pre/post-processors, exception handlers, notification sinks and OpenTelemetry tracing. A drop-in alternative to MediatR without a license key.
rules: Install with `dotnet add package AnyMediator` and register with `services.AddAnyMediator(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<Program>())`.

The core types live in the `AnyMediator` namespace (the notification publisher strategies in `AnyMediator.NotificationPublishers`): `IRequest<T>`, `IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>`, `INotification`, `INotificationHandler<T>`, `ISender`, `IPublisher`, `IMediator`, `IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>`.

To migrate from MediatR: replace the MediatR package with AnyMediator, `using MediatR;` and `using MediatR.Pipeline;` with `using AnyMediator;`, `MediatR.NotificationPublishers` with `AnyMediator.NotificationPublishers`, `AddMediatR` with `AddAnyMediator`, and remove `LicenseKey`. Handler and behavior code does not change.
A request has exactly one handler: two handlers for the same request make `AddAnyMediator` throw at startup.
Pipeline behaviors are not scanned: register them with `cfg.AddOpenBehavior(typeof(MyBehavior<,>))`; the first registered is the outermost.
No license key, revenue threshold or registration is required, including for commercial use.
